scene_purpose: Use the surviving channel and one forced-breach visual to show that the Black Host bypassed a protected Diysean access through weaker surrounding construction, then carry uninterrupted gameplay into the Castellan chamber.

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Connective gameplay beat with one brief breach reaction only.
